description: This is a CMake script used to locate and configure the Rialto library within a build system. It searches for specific header and library files, sets relevant variables, and defines an imported library target if Rialto is found.

methods.name: find_path
methods.description: Searches for a specified header file within given paths.

methods.name: find_library
methods.description: Searches for a specified library file.

methods.name: include
methods.description: Includes another CMake script or module.

methods.name: find_package_handle_standard_args
methods.description: Handles standard arguments for package finding and sets a found flag.

methods.name: mark_as_advanced
methods.description: Marks variables as advanced to hide them in GUIs.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a variable to a specified value.

methods.name: add_library
methods.description: Defines a new library target, in this case an imported shared library.

methods.name: set_target_properties
methods.description: Sets properties for a target, such as location and include directories.
